title: 21 August 1585: the Master of Gray's complaint
caption: Walsingham to Wotton, the Court, 21 August 1585, BL Add MS 32657 ff. 163-164 (DECODE R4840): the clear letter with its two-digit name code, glossed from CSP Scotland viii and Wotton's drafts.
key_note: Name code rebuilt from the bracketed glosses of CSP Scotland viii (1914) and Wotton's drafts R4841-R4843; numbers graded M (3, 27, 28, 29, 36) are marked uncertain; [..] are clear words not yet read. The 10 Sep sign alphabet is another cipher and is not shown.
